cards.title: Glossary
items: G0.2: the coverage join; every declared entity must resolve to a ratified glossary term
G0.3: the confirmation join; every unit's confirmed_by must name a seat on the ratified roster (TC016)
Door: a condition's check at a gate; green should mean it checked something
Declaration: an input a door reads, required at ready so absence cannot pass
Return channel: a consumer's finding goes to the kit as .sdlc/findings/*.yaml or an untracked REQUEST in the kit root
0014: ADR, enforcement change control; a change to what a gate refuses takes its own decision
0029: ADR, one format and a definition of done for the feature document
Check: a one-line acceptance criterion with an id (SC3.1); the contract's acceptance_sketch
Token rule: derived-language's SC3; the verb-first rule reads the word after a leading check id
Two-Key: a unit is done only when the Verifier re-runs the tests independently and grades PASS
ready-green: the contract passes the ready validation profile
Parked: a seat's answer is missing, a dependency is blocked, or an OPEN question stands
